purpose: Authoritative visual-source registry for model-specific engine illustrations. This registry does not itself assert exact installed-engine applicability.

gen1.state: SOURCE IDENTIFIED · EXACT INSTALLED VARIANT PENDING
gen1.requiredIdentity: Confirm engine nameplate serial number and exact suffix (current operator-manual family evidence includes TAD1345GE-B).
gen1.integrationRule: Keep the functional schematic until an exact engine-specific OEM workshop/parts illustration is obtained and its use is authorized. Do not relabel the schematic as OEM geometry.
